title: Forced sewer test.
officialText:
Forced sewer tests shall consist of plugging the end of the building sewer at the point of connection with the
public sewer and applying a pressure of 5 psi (34.5 kPa) greater than the shut off pump rating, and maintaining such pressure for 15
minutes.
